metadata.description: THINK School Growth Team: Capture and Proposal Managed Team plugins for AI-native pursuit work. Bring your own organizational data and approve decisions and deliverables.

plugins.name: proposal-team
plugins.description: Runs a qualified opportunity through a full proposal pipeline -- research, deal assessment, competitive positioning, drafting, and QA -- producing a submission-ready proposal with your approval at each stage, plus a separate grant/funder track. 7 roles: Maya (lead), Chase, Priya, Porter, Quinn, Diego, Blair. Bring your own pricing, case studies, and brand guidelines.

plugins.name: capture-team
plugins.description: THINK School AI Capture Team helps practitioners discover opportunities worth pursuing, qualify and prioritize them against organizational criteria, and turn the resulting intelligence into decision-ready Capture Briefs. Three Digital Employees work together: Chet discovers, Kipp qualifies and prioritizes, and Ben develops capture intelligence and pursuit recommendations.
